read.thesis: Chevron Q3 2026 earnings $9.9B and adjusted $10.4B, with record refinery throughput at 98% utilisation and US production up 27% over two years, while capex fell to $4.0B and net debt dropped $7.8B.

triggers.label: Refinery utilisation near 98%
triggers.quote: reflecting reliable crude unit capacity utilization of nearly 98 percent

triggers.label: Capex $4.0B vs $4.4B year ago
triggers.quote: Capex in the third quarter of 2026 was lower than last year largely due to lower spend in the Permian Basin.

triggers.label: Net debt down $7.8B in quarter
triggers.quote: net debt was down $7.8 billion in the quarter, further strengthening Chevron’s balance sheet.

red_flags.label: Production down 109 kboe/d in international upstream
red_flags.quote: Net oil-equivalent production during the quarter was down 109,000 barrels per day from the year-ago period
